2. Add a pure terminal Markdown renderer exercised against the shared fixture pack: readable heading/list/table/link/code/math/source states, bounded horizontal scrolling or wrapping, and safe explicit targets.
3. Make composer failure recovery durable in-memory: restore exact draft after send failure and add Retry last prompt; preserve source-program/unknown-document input as a saved recovery/handoff artifact.
4. Add deterministic layout tests at 80×24, 100×30, 140×40 across all profile modes, plus no-color/ASCII snapshots.
